decision.explanation: The abbreviation 'IGY' refers to two distinct entities found in the source documents. Document 1 (D1S2) and Document 2 (D2S1) explicitly define 'IGY' as 'International Geophysical Year'. Document 5 (D5S3) defines 'IGY' as 'Israel Gay Youth'. Both are valid expansions of the acronym in their respective contexts, satisfying the requirement to preserve distinct valid referents.
